title: OrchestrationState
description: Runtime state for the NenFlow v3 orchestration status panel, managed by the orchestration-panel extension.

phase.description: Current orchestration phase: INTAKE, RESEARCH, PLAN, EXECUTE, VERIFY, ERROR, COMPLETE

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of last state update

completed.description: When true, the run is finished and the panel should hide

totalSubagents.description: Total number of subagents configured for this run

completedSubagents.description: Count of subagents in completed or failed status

workingSubagents.description: Count of subagents currently in running status

contextPercent.description: Best-effort context window percentage of the currently-running subagent, or null if unknown

contextTokens.description: Approximate context tokens consumed by this subagent

errorMessage.description: Error message if the subagent failed
